title: [Plumbagin protect against sepsis-induced myocardial injury in mice by inhibiting the JAK2/STAT3 signaling pathway to reduce cardiomyocyte pyroptosis].
authors: DU, R; Yun, Q; Wang, Y; Dou, X; Ye, H; Wang, J; Gao, Q
journal: Nan fang yi ke da xue xue bao = Journal of Southern Medical University
one_liner_zh: 该文研究白花丹素通过抑制JAK2/STAT3信号通路减轻脓毒症心肌损伤，分子对接仅用于药物-蛋白结合验证，无蛋白质-DNA互作、TF-DNA体系或AI/物理模拟方法，与本课题无关。
abstract: OBJECTIVE: To explore the mechanism of plumbagin for protecting against sepsis-induced myocardial injury in mice. METHODS: Network pharmacology analysis was used to obtain the key targets of plumbagin and diseases, which were subjected to GO and KEGG analysis, and the binding energy was verified using molecular docking. In a mouse model of cecal ligation and puncture (CLP), the protective effect of plumbagin treatment prior to CLP against sepsis-induced myocardial injury was evaluated by examination of myocardial function and pathology using echocardiography and HE staining. Serum levels of CK-MB, LDH, MDA, IL-1beta and IL-18 and myocardial ROS level in the mice were detected, and Western blotting was used to determine the protein expression levels of STAT3, GSDMD, caspase-11, JAK2, P-STAT3, P-JAK2, GSDMD-N and HMGB1 in the myocardial tissues. RESULTS: Five core targets were screened from the 10 intersecting genes. Molecular docking showed strong binding affinity of plumbagin to STAT3, p-STAT3, and JAK2. Compared with the sham-operated mice, the mouse models of CLP-induced sepsis had significantly decreased CO, LVEF, LVFS and SV and increased serum levels of CK-MB, LDH, MDA and myocardial inflammatory factors and ROS. HE staining and Western blotting showed obvious myocardial injury in the septic mice with increased expressions of JAK2/STAT3 signaling pathway and pyroptosis-related proteins (P < 0.05). Pretreatment with plumbagin significantly improved cardiac functions of CLP mice, lowered serum levels of CK-MB, LDH, MDA, inflammatory factors and myocardial ROS, and decreased the expression levels of JAK2/STAT3 signaling pathway and pyroptosis-related proteins. CONCLUSION: Plumbagin pretreatment alleviates myocardial injury in septic mice possibly by inhibiting the STAT3 signaling pathway to reduce cardiomyocyte pyroptosis.
abstract_zh: 目的：探讨白花丹素对脓毒症诱导小鼠心肌损伤的保护作用机制。方法：采用网络药理学分析获取白花丹素与疾病的关键靶点，并进行GO和KEGG分析，利用分子对接验证结合能。在盲肠结扎穿刺（CLP）小鼠模型中，通过超声心动图和HE染色检测心肌功能和病理，评估CLP前白花丹素预处理对脓毒症诱导心肌损伤的保护作用。检测小鼠血清中CK-MB、LDH、MDA、IL-1β和IL-18水平及心肌ROS水平，并用Western blotting测定心肌组织中STAT3、GSDMD、caspase-11、JAK2、P-STAT3、P-JAK2、GSDMD-N和HMGB1的蛋白表达水平。结果：从10个交集基因中筛选出5个核心靶点。分子对接显示白花丹素与STAT3、p-STAT3和JAK2具有强结合亲和力。与假手术小鼠相比，CLP诱导脓毒症小鼠模型的CO、LVEF、LVFS和SV显著降低，血清CK-MB、LDH、MDA及心肌炎症因子和ROS水平升高。HE染色和Western blotting显示脓毒症小鼠心肌损伤明显，JAK2/STAT3信号通路及焦亡相关蛋白表达增加（P < 0.05）。白花丹素预处理显著改善CLP小鼠心脏功能，降低血清CK-MB、LDH、MDA、炎症因子及心肌ROS水平，并降低JAK2/STAT3信号通路及焦亡相关蛋白表达水平。结论：白花丹素预处理可能通过抑制STAT3信号通路减少心肌细胞焦亡，从而减轻脓毒症小鼠心肌损伤。
